features.description: Local HTTP listener via launchd PORT env (default 8765, --port override), plus extending `ailang coordinator status` to report the bound listener
acceptance_criteria: lsof -p $(cat ~/.ailang/coordinator.pid) -nP shows TCP listener on port 8765 within 60s of `make coord-install`
curl -s -H 'X-API-Key: $KEY' http://127.0.0.1:8765/health returns 200 with {"status":"ok"}
`ailang coordinator status` includes a 'HTTP: ✓ http://127.0.0.1:8765' line
--port 9999 override works (daemon binds to chosen port)
tools/launchd/dev.ailang.coordinator.plist.template has EnvironmentVariables dict with PORT
tools/launchd/install_coordinator.sh accepts --port flag and substitutes into template
features.notes: Verified live: plist + installer + status probe. Daemon now binds 127.0.0.1:8765 by default; /health returns 200; `ailang coordinator status` shows new HTTP line. Commit 49664aaf.

features.description: Add --requires CLI flag to `ailang messages send`; threads comma-separated tags into messagestore.Requires field; new TestSendWithRequires
acceptance_criteria: `ailang messages send eval-rig 'test' --requires agent:motoko` exits 0
`ailang messages read <id> --raw | jq .requires` returns ["agent:motoko"]
Comma-separated form `--requires 'agent:motoko,ollama:gemma4-26b-ailang'` parses to a 2-element slice
TestSendWithRequires in cmd/ailang/messages_send_test.go passes
`go test ./cmd/ailang/... -run TestSendWithRequires -count=20` deterministic (no map-iteration nondeterminism)
docs/docs/guides/agent-messaging.md has 'Tag-routed sends' subsection with example
features.notes: Verified live + 4 deterministic tests (count=20). --requires routes via HTTP POST /api/messages (reuses M1 port discovery). Negative-path: clear error with `make coord-install` hint when listener unreachable. SQLite-only path unchanged when --requires absent. Commit 9544139a.

features.description: Update coordinator-workers + agent-messaging guides, add CHANGELOG entry, run the 3-scenario end-to-end verification matrix (Studio→Studio, Laptop→cloud→Studio, cloud-fallback)
acceptance_criteria: Scenario 1 (Studio→Studio local tag match): `ailang messages send eval-rig 'fizzbuzz_smoke' --requires agent:motoko` from Studio completes, ailang chains view shows compile=✓ runtime=✓ stdout=✓
Scenario 2 (Laptop→cloud→Studio via Pub/Sub): same command from a non-Studio host hitting the cloud coordinator URL reaches the Studio and completes
Scenario 3 (cloud-fallback): with Studio stopped via launchctl bootout, the same message is claimed by ailang-agent-executor-motoko Cloud Run Job and completes

changelogs/v0.10-current.md has M-COORD-TAG-ROUTING-LASTMILE entry covering all 4 milestones + the 3 verified scenarios
